mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition for activation.
failure_condition: The Spearman rank correlation (Rank IC) between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is negative or less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with a rising unemployment rate signals an economic slowdown that increases equity risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * UNRATE) has a positive Rank IC with 60-day SPX returns, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a low unemployment rate signals strong labor market conditions that support corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts rate above 1,350,000 units signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1350.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production signals robust economic activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and does not require a threshold condition for activation.
failure_condition: The Spearman rank correlation (Rank IC) between INDPRO and 20-day SPX returns is negative or less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong retail sales (RSAFS) and rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust consumer and business demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (RSAFS * INDPRO) has a negative Rank IC with 20-day SPX returns, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime (RSAFS > 700000.0), a high retail sales figure signals sustained consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 700000.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
